author: KEXP
description: Chicago's Gia Margaret is a delicate force of nature on her first vocal album in nearly a decade. Live on KEXP with host Alex Ruder, her angelic vocals and tender instrumentation are on full display with a performance of "Alive Inside" and more from 'Singing.'
title: Gia Margaret performs "Alive Inside" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Gia Margaret performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded June 19, 2026.

Everyone Around Me Dancing 00:45
Alive Inside 04:09
Good Friend 09:24
E-Motion 13:44

Gia Margaret - Vocal, keys, guitar
Ryan Hemsworth - Sampling, programming
Adam Schatz - Saxophone
Abby Gundersen - Keys, Vox, Violin

Host: Alex Ruder

Mastering Engineer: Julian Martlew
